subject: Request: Dedicated L40S bridge + short-term discount & reservation hold
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@veridianhealth.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: Dedicated capacity need for June launch

Hi Lauren,

We're ramping toward a June pilot for our triage assistant and ran into a scheduling/availability issue with our preferred H100 pool. Our infra lead flagged that an immediate warm reserve on Redwood Dedicated is the only way to guarantee the latency SLA for the pilot.

Two asks: can Redwood hold a dedicated block for ~4x L40S equivalents for 9 months (we were planning 12, but we need earlier start) and confirm temporary burst capacity for the first 8 weeks of launch? Procurement also asked if there is any bridging credit or transient discount you can offer given the shortened term.

I can share the runbook and capacity forecast if helpful. We need to move quickly — can you advise on next steps and what approvals are required?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Infrastructure, Veridian Health
procurement@veridianhealth.ai

----

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Dedicated capacity need for June launch

Samantha — thanks for the context and the runbook. Looping in Priyom and Karthik to scope feasibility and exec approval needs.

Quick answers:
- We can provision an L40S-equivalent pool as a temporary bridge, but that requires an approved SKU substitution and a reservation hold so we don’t commit the capacity elsewhere.
- Shortening the non-cancellable term from 12→9 months is non-standard; that lands with deal desk + exec signoff.
- Bridging credit / launch discount: needs Exec signoff and finance alignment.

Priyom — can you confirm the technical fit for L40S against their latency targets and an estimate of token throughput? Karthik — marking this for your review re: discount and reservation hold window.

Lauren

lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

On Mon, Mar 15, 2027 at 10:03 AM Lauren Bishop wrote:
> Priyom — can you confirm the technical fit for L40S...

Quick technical take: L40S (or equivalent) will meet their 95th percentile latency target for the prompt shapes in the runbook at the expected concurrency if we reserve 4 cards (pool of 4 devices) and enable continuous batching + prefix cache. We should size for a 20% headroom during the 8-week launch burst.

Estimate: baseline monthly capacity (non-burst) ~ 7.5M tokens; burst weeks add ~2.2M tokens/week.

Risks/notes:
- L40S is available to reserve today; H100 inventory is constrained in their target region (us-west).
- Performance parity: L40S has ~10–15% slower throughput on some attention-heavy prompts; we mitigate with batching and a short-term quantization profile.

I'll attach a one-page proposed runbook with exact throughput numbers. If legal/finance require a precise replacement clause, we can draft the amendment.

Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: veridian_capacity_runbook.pdf (updated, 2 pages stub)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@veridianhealth.ai>
Date: 2027-03-19T11:46:00-07:00
Subject: ACTION: Exec approval needed — L40S bridge, 9mo term, launch credits, 14-day reservation hold

Karthik — summarizing the ask and why we need exec-level concession:

Customer: Veridian Health (VD-4821) — launching pilot in June; wants an earlier start than H100 availability.

Requested concessions:
1) SKU substitution: provision L40S-equivalent dedicated pool (4 devices) for 9 months (customer reduces term to get earlier start).
2) Transient launch burst: guaranteed +20% throughput for first 8 weeks above baseline.
3) Bridging credit: customer requested $75k offset for shortened term and performance delta.
4) Reservation hold: hold the capacity for 14 calendar days while procurement finalizes the amendment.

Impact/compensation: our recommended counter is below — we think this balances revenue protection with speed-to-production: 
- Offer 15% credit on committed monthly fees for first 2 months (not 3)
- One-time bridging credit of $50,000 if contract signed within the 14-day hold window
- Reservation hold limited to 10 calendar days (not 14) unless legal approves an extended soft hold with a partial hold fee
- Include a replacement-SKU clause: if H100 becomes available within 60 days, Redwood may trigger a best-effort migration with 30 days notice and pro-rated rate adjustment

Requested approvals:
- Exec signoff on discount & bridging credit (Karthik)
- Finance/RevOps cleanup on amendment and invoice timing

Attachments: proposed_amendment_draft.pdf (contains draft term language and replacement-SKU clause)

Recommend: approve the counter above to keep the deal moving — they have competitive timelines and early pilot traction.

Lauren

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@veridianhealth.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACTION: Exec approval needed — L40S bridge, 9mo term, launch credits, 14-day reservation hold

Thanks Lauren — reviewed the ask and Priyom's sizing. I approve with modifications:

Approved concessions (final):
- SKU substitution to L40S-equivalent for a 9-month committed term (VD-4821).
- Transient launch burst capacity: guaranteed as described (20% headroom) for 8 weeks.
- Financials: 15% credit on committed monthly fees for the first 2 months (as recommended).
- Bridging credit: approve one-time $50,000 credit contingent on signed amendment within 10 calendar days of this approval (reservation hold window).
- Reservation hold: approve a 10-calendar-day soft hold; if customer needs extension beyond 10 days, they will be charged a 25% hold fee of one month's committed payment for each additional 7-day block.

Conditions:
1) Legal must add the replacement-SKU clause and migration notice language in the amendment.
2) Finance must confirm revenue recognition plan for the $50k credit and mark deal for RevOps review.
3) Sales to finalize and send proposed amendment via DocuSign within 24 hours of this approval.

Lauren/Priyom — please update the amendment per conditions and route to DocuSign. If procurement signs inside 10 days we honor the $50k credit and the 10-day reservation hold.

Karthik
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
